question: The SEWA Cooperative Bank was first initiated in ________ in the year ________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ahmedabad, 1974**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **SEWA Cooperative Bank** was initiated in **Ahmedabad**, Gujarat, in the year **1974**.
 
• The bank was created under the auspices of the **Self-Employed Women’s Association (SEWA)**, which was founded by **Ela Bhatt** in 1972.
 
• Its primary goal is to provide **financial services** to **self-employed women**, enabling them to save, access credit, and enhance their livelihoods.
 
• The bank operates as a cooperative
